scripts.source-copy: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('source', {recursive:true}); for (const f of ['notebook.html', 'study.js', 'package.json', 'study.test.js']) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'source/' + f + '.txt');"
scripts.build: npm run source-copy && notebooks build --root . -- notebook.html
